title: EVERY FIELD SAYS HOW IT IS KNOWN
question: How does each normalized field communicate its evidence state?
takeaway: A value remains distinguishable as observed, derived, operator asserted, provider asserted, or unavailable.

reading_speeds.at_2_seconds: Four evidence origins lead to five exact status labels.
reading_speeds.at_20_seconds: Retained artifacts support observed values, named transforms support derived values, people or providers support asserted values, and missing support stays unavailable.
reading_speeds.at_2_minutes: The five wire-level enum values, source requirement, and null boundary map directly to the normalized model and JSON schemas.

medium.rationale: The exact five status strings and their distinctions must remain selectable, diffable, and legible on mobile.

labels.claim: The value is present in a named retained run artifact.
The value is computed from named retained evidence.
An operator supplied or reconstructed the value.
A provider-side source supplied the value.
The retained evidence cannot establish a value; the value is null.

labels.text: STATUS + SOURCE TRAVEL WITH THE FIELD
labels.claim: Available evidence values include both an evidence status and a source string.

boundaries: A configured value is not upgraded to observed unless a retained artifact supports it.
Assertions remain assertions even when plausible.
Unavailable evidence is represented as null rather than guessed.

accessibility.alt_text: Four origins map to five evidence statuses: retained artifact to observed, named transform to derived, operator or provider statement to their respective asserted statuses, and no retained support to unavailable.
accessibility.long_description: Four vertically arranged source groups each point to exact status pills. Found in a retained artifact maps to observed. Computed from named inputs maps to derived. Stated by someone maps to operator asserted and provider asserted. Not established maps to unavailable. A footer says status and source travel with the field.

provenance.method: deterministic SVG from validated semantic brief and paired render manifest
